prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent PNG VFX animation source sheet for an original 2D chibi wuxia RPG, Nam De elderly saffron monk boss. Make ONE clean 4 columns by 4 rows grid, exactly sixteen fully separated painted animation cels, all equal cell sizes with generous empty transparent margins. No text, no characters, no UI, no labels, no grid lines, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Detailed crisp pixel art, white-hot ivory cores, amber gold outlines, sparse glint pixels, dark amber edge pixels, no soft blur. Elevated orthographic three-quarter overworld visual perspective, ground rings are flattened ellipses.
Row 1, four sequential distinct frames: a horizontal golden dash wake to the RIGHT, narrow wisps and clothlike energy ribbons leaving behind from left, no figure, anticipation small, stretched streak, broken streak, dissipating sparks.
Row 2, four sequential distinct frames: close-contact acupuncture fingertip impact seal, tiny central white-gold pinprick blossoms into intricate thin gold knot with TWO paired small pressure-point dots, then seal contracts and breaks into four motes. NO flying missile.
Row 3, four sequential distinct frames: DIZZINESS / disorientation halo above a victim head, a delicate tilted orbital ring with three tiny gold lotus-stars and ghostly pale-cyan offset echoes, changing orbit positions between frames, hollow transparent center, no shield or healing cross. Small size, readable at 48 pixels.
Row 4, four sequential distinct frames: a single very thin vertical divine FINGER RAY striking downward from sky, long slim ivory-gold shaft upper middle with narrow arrow tip down, lands at a small elliptical golden point burst at the bottom of the cell, then a lingering slender shaft and small sparks, then dissolution. All cels entirely inside margins, no cropping at edges. This is a usable sprite source, not a promotional montage. Preserve gold visual identity and fine energy detail. Transparent background.
notes: Generated PNG actual size 1261x1247. Four-row original VFX source; cropped/padded PNGs are staged preview candidates. Existing Nam De actor/concepts unchanged.
